newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ reaffirms margins seen contracting.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ reaffirms margins seen contracting.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd's margins are expected to contract in fiscal 1996/97, chief executive officer Don Mercer said.

"The benefits of growth are likely to be partially offset by a further contraction of interest margins in Australia and New Zealand in the year ahead," Mercer said in the bank's annual report. The chief executive had warned of tighter margins last month when ANZ reported a six percent rise in net profit to A$1.12 billion for the year to September 30.
ANZ said in the report that intense competitive pressures would continue in the Australian financial services industry and the bank's key task would be to complete its restructuring initiatives.
"This will involve some branch closures as banking services are increasingly delivered to customers using electronic channels," it said.
Competitive pressures also would remain in the New Zealand market, ANZ said.
"Increasing disintermediation by corporate borrowers may dampen demand for traditional banking products and services from (the mortgage) sector," it said.
ANZ's international operations were seen growing at a faster rate than domestic operations and the bank would continue to expand its greenfield operations in Asia, ANZ said.
ANZ's best offshore opportunities were seen in the card-based and investment banking sectors, the bank ANZ said.
